result.instructions: Tools for Picqer, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are still waiting to be picked today?"; "How much stock do we have of product 6531 in each warehouse?"; "Pause order 30130012 because the delivery address is incomplete.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Picqer data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run picqer_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run picqer_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run picqer_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. picqer_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: picqer_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List active products with name, product code, price, supplier and stock settings. Use search for a fuzzy match on name, code or barcode, or productcode for one exact product. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/products.

search.description: Fuzzy search on name, product code, supplier product code and barcode.

productcode.description: Exact product code; returns the one matching product.

tag.description: Only products with this tag name.

idsupplier.description: Only products linked to this supplier id.

offset.description: Skip this many rows. Lists return 100 rows per call.

sinceid.description: Only rows with a higher id. Use 0 to start a full sync.

beforeid.description: Only rows with a lower id. Use the lowest id of the previous page.

tools.name: picqer_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with its prices, supplier and settings. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/products/{idproduct}.

tools.name: picqer_get_product_stock
tools.title: Get product stock
tools.description: Get stock of one product per warehouse: stock, reserved, reserved by picklists or backorders, and free stock. Give idwarehouse to get the locations of one warehouse. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/products/{idproduct}/stock[/{idwarehouse}].

idwarehouse.description: Only this warehouse, with its locations.

tools.name: picqer_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders with status, customer, delivery address and warehouses. Filter by status, customer, warehouse, tag, order number or date. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/orders.

search.description: Search orderid, reference, customer name and customer contact name.

idcustomer.description: Only orders of this customer id.

idwarehouse.description: Only orders that can be delivered from this warehouse id.

tag.description: Only orders with this tag name.

sincedate.description: Orders added after this date and time, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

untildate.description: Orders added before this date and time, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

offset.description: Skip this many rows. Lists return 100 rows per call.

sinceid.description: Only rows with a higher id. Use 0 to start a full sync.

beforeid.description: Only rows with a lower id. Use the lowest id of the previous page.

tools.name: picqer_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order with its products, delivery and invoice address, notes and tags. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/orders/{idorder}.

tools.name: picqer_pause_order
tools.title: Pause an order
tools.description: Pause an order that has status processing, with a reason (for example a wrong address). Its open picklists are paused too. Reverse with picqer_resume_order. Picqer API: POST /api/v1/orders/{idorder}/pause.

reason.description: Why the order is paused. Picqer requires a reason.

tools.name: picqer_resume_order
tools.title: Resume an order
tools.description: Resume a paused order: its status returns to processing and its picklists resume. Picqer API: POST /api/v1/orders/{idorder}/resume.

tools.name: picqer_get_customer
